full_page.content:
Page 270 Mar. 31 Wm. Preuss - lutheran - 6 - brain-injury at birth ... mind of a 10 month baby.
Thanks - Jerome Green - 25 - has wife and child .. nearly killed on Wash. Birthday - Explosion of gas - was threatened with total blind- ness - was prayed for here - mother promising perpetual Enrollment if sight were saved ..... is O.K.
Joan Labadie - 59 - full of cancer ..... lungs fill up etc ... Mrs. Anna Woods - 67 - nerve fearful head-aches
Mrs. Cora Stimpson - 63 - hiccups for days & nights .... Enrolled in Ser. Mass.
1941, April
Apr. 2 Jos. Supp .... refuses to "make Mrs. .. married in Toledo.
Sallie Lu McGann - 11 - strep poison of some kind - prayed for on St. Joseph day as hopeless and unconscious with spinal maningitis - quite improving ... All surprised .... yesterday had first solid food in two weeks, was "April fooling" all day.
Page 271
April 2 Mrs. Myrtle Addison - 48 - Stroke 22 yrs ago. After husband's recov- ery of very serious operation and 6 months confinement in Rochester Hospital. She has had about 30 slighter strokes since ... anointed a number of times.
Joseph Ciaranino - 23 - Sinus operation last Jan. 15th - still in Hosp ..
Geo. Thompson - 52 - 4 times stricken with pneumonia in 8 months - given up in last case as absolutely hopeless; now hard of hearing and weak vision.
Floyd Mayes - 46 - head-aches and nerve trouble.
6 Joseph Ciaravino - 23 - very serious sinus - operation ten days ago ..
8 Mrs. Emma Jarrett - 64 - Cancer feared - going to Mt. Carmel Hospital.
9 Mr Higgins - about 50 - in Ford's-throat - stroke - very poorly .....
